prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, but underestimated gains from home notifications, adoption new flows, choose path layouts, and desktop finish audio flows.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), home notifications (home, notification), adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow), and choose path layouts (choose_path, layout) were helpful in multiple winning tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) hurt performance (causing rollbacks) or showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests of that kind to establish a pattern.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, new_flow] Sign In Interactive Account Selection Flow: Add an interactive choice card flow on the sign_in screen allowing users to choose explicitly between cloud pet backup and quick guest mode. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, showing users need clearer cloud sync options during sign in.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Story Scroll Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose path screen with a story_scroll layout to guide users seamlessly through path selection. (why: Choose path screen has a long mean time (514s); layout redesigns in choose_path were highlighted as winning strategies in previous tests.)
2: [choose_path, new_screen] Add New Path Selection Overview Screen: Add a new path summary screen before path selection to clearly contrast preset pets versus custom pet creation. (why: Choose path step takes median 8s but mean 514s, indicating a segment of users gets stuck deciding without context.)
3: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Habitat Notification Alert: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen to inform users when their desktop habitat is ready. (why: Home notifications showed strong conversion gains in past winning tests, and waiting screen has high mean wait duration (2336s).)
4: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Spotlight Layout Refresh: Update the initial story screen layout to spotlight mode to focus attention on the app's companion concept. (why: Choose path layout improvements historically drove positive conversion gains in early onboarding steps.)
5: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Stage Layout Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a compact stage layout with dynamic visual preview components. (why: Adoption new flows and redesigns have repeatedly proven successful in improving conversion rates.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Stage Progress Status Display: Add explicit stage progress indicators and step counter displays to the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has the longest mean delay (2336s mean), making transparent stage progress valuable to prevent drop-off.)
7: [adoption, layout] Upload Photos Two Column Layout Refresh: Refresh the photo upload screen into a two-column layout separating instructions from the photo preview area. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet photo creation fails or looks wrong; a cleaner split layout improves photo submission clarity.)
8: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Existing Pet Account Recovery Copy Refresh: Rewrite sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly assure users that signing in syncs and restores existing pets. (why: 8 support emails were received regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)

scores.note: Supported by user support complaints, but interactive sign-in flows are untested and costly to build.
Conflates layout tweaks with full redesigns, which historically hurt conversion (-1.6% to -5.8%).
Adding new screens in early/late steps historically hurts performance (-5.2% for finish, -1.4% for choose_path).
Home notifications are proven effective (+2.7% lift across 4 tests) addressing long waiting times.
Choose path layout changes are proven winners (+0.8% average lift across 5 tests).
Adoption redesigns consistently reduce conversion (-3.1% lift across 3 tests).
Home wait_info improvements consistently yield positive results (+0.9% across 4 tests).
Strong support mail evidence for photo upload step, but specific adoption layout type has 0 previous tests.
Cheap copy-only fix with support evidence, but sign-in copy tweaks historically fail (-1.6% across 4 tests).
